verdict.rationale: The docs say scheduled tasks can start when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs. They pitch this as acting on new email, channel activity, or PR feedback without polling, which is event-driven subscription limited to three first-party integrations. There is no evidence of a general webhook mechanism, either inbound URLs to trigger tasks or outbound webhooks to notify external systems; the OpenAPI probe also found no API spec. Missing for 10: generic webhook endpoints, outbound event notifications, custom event sources beyond Gmail/Slack/GitHub, payload and delivery documentation, independent corroboration.
